newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values rise on Spain interest.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values rise on Spain interest.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values rose several cents for March shipment in reaction to expected sales to Spain, grain dealers said.
Soybean and winter wheat values were mostly unchanged in light dealings , grain dealers said.

Dealers said Spain was seeking corn for prompt shipment. European grain sources reported Thursday that the European Union agreed to allow Spain to import 32,000 tonnes of corn under a reduced import tariff, and Portugal could import 90,000 tonnes under a reduced tariff.
